claims_extracted.claim: Fuzzball is an operating system and applications library for PDP-11/LSI-11 systems, not merely a routing application.
The network software dedicates input/output supervisor processes to interfaces and separates Internet-common, local-network and device-specific driver layers.
Packets can be forwarded from input to output using the same buffer without copying.
The system contains a 1000 Hz logical clock with frequency/phase control and supports HELLO/Hellospeak and Internet time-synchronization work.
